periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, sloping downwards towards the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid morphology with a length-to-width ratio of approximately 1.7:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering resulting in an elongated teardrop shape with a low-set geometric center.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation between ears, roughly equivalent to the width of the cranial vault between them.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded, hemispherical curvature at the superior margin.
